title: Long-term Public Humanities Fellowships

compensation.value: $70,000 for a standard period of 9 months
compensation.evidence_quote: For the 2027-28 year, the Folger Institute will offer Long-term Public Humanities Fellowships at $70,000 for a standard period of 9 months

about: Folger Institute Long-term Public Humanities Fellowships for 2027-28, a standard nine-month period of which up to three months may be virtual. Applications need a 250-word abstract and a 1,500-word project description with a public humanities engagement; due December 15, 11:59 pm ET.
requirements: A terminal degree is not required; applicants describe equivalent training and industry-specific experience in their CV
card_alt: Card for the Long-term Public Humanities Fellowships at the Folger Shakespeare Library, Folger Institute, Washington, United States; deadline 15 Dec 2026. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Washington.
